name: moxywolf-plugins
description: Canonical MoxyWolf plugin marketplace. Hosts every plugin authored by MoxyWolf LLC plus a bundle of the standalone skills used across the team. Source of truth lives in the MoxyWolf Vault on Google Drive.

plugins.name: 4d-blog-engine
plugins.description: Operationalizes the 4D AI Fluency Framework (Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence) for content production. /blog-init is writer-friendly: two folder picks, author name, hero vibe, optional live URL. /blog-voice runs a self-contained 8-question voice interview and writes a per-writer voice profile at <blog-project-dir>/<author-slug>-voice.md; multi-voice supported (run /blog-voice repeatedly for guest contributors). The pipeline globs *-voice.md and asks which voice to use when there are more than one — fully decoupled from any preset voice. /blog-start mounts the two directories and surfaces in-progress and unpublished pieces. /blog runs the 4-phase pipeline: 30-day discourse sweep across reddit/X/HN/Substack/Facebook/Quora/podcasts/academic with a /council:deliberate synthesis pass, verified bibliography via bibtex-builder, draft in the writer's voice via research-pipeline/content-writer, two-tier anti-AI-slop pass, then a nonce-bound Release Owner Gate (100-point rubric) before a long-form LinkedIn article and a short hook-led teaser are derived. /publish ships a signed post — the writer never types a git command. Implements the Release Owner Gate from MoxyWolf's Beyond the Prompt whitepaper.

plugins.name: academic-pipeline
plugins.description: End-to-end academic content pipeline: BibTeX theme mapping, perspective and voice capture, Academia.edu formatting, structure planning, iterative drafting, bibliography generation, and a 10-phase professor critique. Voice-first — voice and formatting are fixed before drafting, not retrofitted.

plugins.name: board-deck
plugins.description: Generate MoxyWolf monthly board deck from LivePlan, GA4, Taskade, and GitHub data.

plugins.name: bibtex-builder
plugins.description: Build and enrich BibTeX bibliographies with AI-generated abstracts from URLs or uploaded .bib files.

plugins.name: composio
plugins.description: Composio integration for Cowork. Teaches Claude to use Composio's Tool Router — 1000+ app toolkits through a session-based MCP connector — for apps with no native connector. Native MCPs stay first; Composio is the reach layer.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Multi-model AI deliberation with vault-aware institutional memory — structured consensus from multiple LLMs with self-learning routing, self-improving prompts, and bidirectional Obsidian vault integration.

plugins.name: daily-ops
plugins.description: Energy-aware personal operations system with Inbox Intelligence and Fitness Coach. Combines Apple HealthKit/Oura (via Health Auto Export), Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Drive tasks, and an Apple-Health-aware daily workout coach.

plugins.name: dev-infrastructure-skills
plugins.description: Framework-specific development best practices for React, Next.js, Supabase/Postgres, TDD, and Playwright E2E testing.

plugins.name: editorial-forge
plugins.description: Transform AI-generated content into author-owned work through structured editorial judgment, voice extraction, and Sorkin DOB narrative framing — with a complete authorship record.

plugins.name: frontier-founder
plugins.description: Tooling for The Frontier Founder site. /blog-post converts any draft markdown file into a publication-ready blog post — frontmatter formatting, MoxyWolf typographic rules, a brand-aligned hero image, and slug-tied file naming, saved into the FrontierFounder repo.

plugins.name: gstack-execution
plugins.description: Software development execution engine adapted from Garry Tan's gstack (MIT). Code review, security audit, debugging, QA testing, and shipping. Pairs with product-orchestrator. Browser ops via Claude in Chrome.

plugins.name: github-repo-analyzer
plugins.description: Analyze GitHub repositories for health, tech-stack conformance, security-classified issue reviews (CWE/OWASP/NIST), HITL code-fix suggestions, closure verification, and reverse-engineered PRDs. Uses native GitHub MCP + gh CLI / REST.

plugins.name: obsidian-update
plugins.description: Vault-native personal operating system with Council integration. Energy-aware daily ops, three-layer persistent memory, Kanban task management, and session knowledge extraction into the MoxyWolf Obsidian vault.

plugins.name: product-orchestrator
plugins.description: Product decision engine that wraps Council deliberation with product-specific role prompts for scope, architecture, and GTM decisions. Maintains decision records in the Obsidian vault.

plugins.name: project-init
plugins.description: Cowork project lifecycle for MoxyWolf projects. /init-project scaffolds tailored Project Instructions. /session-start auto-resolves the project — explicit argument, then launch directory, then the most recently active project, never a picker — mounts the three standard roots, reads the previous session's handoff including the `author` / `for` baton-pass fields, and probes the team-shared OpenRouter key (DR-010). /session-end asks who authored the handoff and whether it's a baton-pass, writes the canonical handoff with `author` / `for` frontmatter, supports --author / --handoff-to / --solo, refreshes each writable repo's README.md, then runs /obsidian-update.

plugins.name: research-pipeline
plugins.description: End-to-end academic research pipeline: literature discovery, citation verification, thematic synthesis, and perspective-driven content generation. AutoResearchClaw-inspired.

plugins.name: saas-frontend-designer
plugins.description: Full-pipeline front-end design system for SaaS products and marketing sites. Generates, polishes, audits, and optimizes production-ready Next.js + React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui interfaces.

plugins.name: saas-pricing-engine
plugins.description: End-to-end SaaS and API gateway pricing research, modeling, and copywriting. Combines competitor intelligence, pricing frameworks (Van Westendorp, Gabor-Granger, value-based), and conversion-optimized pricing-page generation.

plugins.name: team-kanban
plugins.description: Aggregates tasks from Obsidian Kanban, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Gmail, and Slack into a team-visible Slack Canvas kanban board with dual-authority completion and automatic sync-back.

plugins.name: vtt-to-text
plugins.description: Converts pasted WebVTT closed-caption content into clean, readable text. Strips timestamps, merges into flowing paragraphs.

plugins.name: moxywolf-skills
plugins.description: Bundle of 25 standalone skills used across MoxyWolf work — voice, brand, content ecosystems, plus the Anthropic-shipped reference skills, packaged as one installable plugin. (daily-ops moved out of the bundle in v1.1.0 — install the standalone plugin instead.)
